name: Greek yogurt
description: Yogurt with the whey strained out — thicker, and double the protein.

tcm.note: Follows plain yogurt; straining removes water, not nature.

ayurveda.note: Dahi is ushna whatever you strain out of it.

unani.note: Thanda like dahi, though less watery than the desi original.

histamine.note: Young culture, like plain yogurt — the aged cheeses are the problem, not this.

nutrition.highlight: double the protein of plain yogurt

guna.note: Soured and cultured dairy is read as heavier than fresh milk, and traditionally avoided at night.

effects.note: Straining removes whey, not the live Lactobacillus bulgaricus and Streptococcus thermophilus cultures behind yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect — the dedicated trials tested regular yogurt rather than the strained kind specifically, so this carries over by mechanism rather than a dedicated trial of its own. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
